test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Among the four words listed, three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Option (1) Bitter → Type of taste.

Option (2) Salty → Type of taste.

Option (3) Sour → Type of taste.

**Option (4) ****Delicious**** → Not type of taste.**

Hence, **“****Delicious****”** is an odd one.</p
